verdict_rationale: NPPES (National Plan and Provider Enumeration System) is a CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) federal registry. All NPI holders are required by law to register and maintain public information under 45 CFR §162.408 (HIPAA Administrative Simplification). CMS explicitly releases NPPES bulk data as a free public download with no restrictions on commercial use. The NPPES Public Use File (PUF) is designed for public disclosure — CMS states: 'The NPI and the provider information associated with it are available for public use'. Fields: NPI, name, credential, practice name, specialty taxonomy, practice address, phone — all mandatory public registry fields. No SSNs, DOB, personal financial data, or home addresses (practice location only). Precedent: NPPES Physical Therapists (377K records, $79) approved and shipped 2026-05-07. Dental data is the exact same federal public registry. USADoctorList.com sells dentist lists at $97/state = $4,800+ for national coverage from this same source. PASS.

pii_check.notes: Practice location address (not home address). All information is mandatory public disclosure under 45 CFR 162.408. Same legal basis as NPPES PT dataset already approved and shipped.
